items.title: EU: Russia 'not ready for peace' with 'no tangible signs' of serious engagement
items.title_zh: 歐盟：俄羅斯「尚未準備好和平」，沒有認真談判的跡象
items.desc: The European Union says there are 'no tangible signs that Russia is engaging seriously' with the aim of securing peace in Ukraine. EU spokesperson emphasized that Russia continues its relentless attacks on Ukraine ahead of peace talks.
items.desc_zh: 歐盟表示，沒有看到俄羅斯認真參與烏克蘭和平談判的跡象。歐盟發言人強調，即使在和平談判前夕，俄羅斯仍持續對烏克蘭發動猛烈攻擊。

items.title: Top European spies sceptical US will clinch Ukraine peace deal this year
items.title_zh: 歐洲情報首長懷疑美國今年能否敲定烏克蘭和平協議
items.desc: European intelligence officials are skeptical about the prospects of a US-brokered peace deal in Ukraine, citing Russia's continued military aggression and lack of genuine diplomatic engagement.
items.desc_zh: 歐洲情報官員對美國斡旋的烏克蘭和平協議前景持懷疑態度，理由是俄羅斯持續的軍事侵略和缺乏真正的外交參與。

items.title: Trump administration balances Ukraine talks and Russia deal prospects
items.title_zh: 特朗普政府在烏克蘭談判與俄羅斯交易前景之間尋求平衡
items.desc: The U.S. concluded another round of talks to end the war in Ukraine as the White House pressured Ukraine while exploring potential business opportunities with Russia.
items.desc_zh: 美國結束了另一輪旨在結束烏克蘭戰爭的談判，白宮在對烏克蘭施壓的同時，探索與俄羅斯的潛在商業機會。

items.title: US-brokered talks between Ukrainian and Russian delegations ended in Geneva
items.title_zh: 美國斡旋的烏克蘭與俄羅斯代表團談判在日內瓦結束
items.desc: US-mediated peace talks between Russia and Ukraine concluded in Geneva. Ukrainian President Zelensky said the trilateral meeting fell short of his country's goals.
items.desc_zh: 美國斡旋的俄烏和平談判在日內瓦結束。烏克蘭總統澤連斯基表示，三方會談未能達到烏克蘭的目標。

items.title: Russia is losing influence over neighbouring post-Soviet states, report says
items.title_zh: 報告稱俄羅斯正在失去對鄰國後蘇聯國家的影響力
items.desc: A Kremlin-aligned think tank reports that Russia's war in Ukraine has drained Moscow's resources and strengthened neighboring states' push for greater independence.
items.desc_zh: 克里姆林宮智庫報告指出，俄羅斯在烏克蘭的戰爭耗盡了莫斯科的資源，並增強了鄰國尋求更大獨立性的動力。

items.title: China's Unitree Aims to Ship 20,000 Humanoid Robots in 2026
items.title_zh: 中國宇樹科技計劃2026年出貨2萬台人形機器人
items.desc: Unitree Robotics is planning a major production ramp-up, aiming to ship up to 20,000 humanoid robots in 2026, marking a sharp rise from roughly 5,500 units shipped last year.
items.desc_zh: 宇樹科技計劃大幅增產，目標在2026年出貨多達2萬台人形機器人，較去年約5,500台的出貨量大幅增長。

items.title: China's robot revolution in motion
items.title_zh: 中國機器人革命進行中
items.desc: China's robotics sector benefits from an integrated supply chain that compresses development cycles and lowers costs, with domestic AI chipmakers and sensor manufacturers operating in dense geographic clusters.
items.desc_zh: 中國機器人行業受益於整合供應鏈，縮短開發週期並降低成本，國內AI芯片製造商和傳感器製造商在地理上形成密集的產業集群。

items.title: Should we be amused or afraid of China's 'kung fu robots'?
items.title_zh: 對於中國的「功夫機器人」我們該感到有趣還是害怕？
items.desc: China showcased humanoid robots performing martial arts at the Spring Festival Gala. Morgan Stanley projects China's humanoid robot sales will more than double to 28,000 units in 2026.
items.desc_zh: 中國在春晚展示了表演武術的人形機器人。摩根士丹利預測，2026年中國人形機器人銷量將增長一倍以上，達到2.8萬台。

items.title: 2026 Government Work Report: Basic livelihood secured
items.title_zh: 2026年政府工作報告：基本民生得到保障
items.desc: China's government work report highlights progress in employment, housing, and social security. 595 job fairs held with 421,700 job positions offered, achieving employment for 50,400 people.
items.desc_zh: 中國政府工作報告強調在就業、住房和社会保障方面取得進展。舉辦招聘會595場，提供就業崗位42.17萬個，實現就業5.04萬人次。

items.title: Tesla Market Cap Surpasses All Major Automakers Combined
items.title_zh: 特斯拉市值超越所有主要汽車製造商總和
items.desc: Tesla's market capitalization now exceeds the combined market cap of Toyota, BYD, GM, Ford, Hyundai, Kia, Mercedes-Benz, Stellantis, Geely, Ferrari, BMW, Volkswagen Group, Honda, Nissan, Renault, XPENG, and NIO.
items.desc_zh: 特斯拉的市值現已超過豐田、比亞迪、通用、福特、現代、起亞、奔馳、Stellantis、吉利、法拉利、寶馬、大眾集團、本田、日產、雷諾、小鵬和蔚來的市值總和。

items.title: Hong Kong's primary property market sees 17 transactions in CNY holiday
items.title_zh: 香港一手物業市場農曆新年假期錄得17宗成交
items.desc: Hong Kong's primary property market has recorded 17 valuable transactions during the first two days of the Chinese New Year Holiday, including 10 units in Central Residence By The Park.
items.desc_zh: 香港一手物業市場在農曆新年假期首兩天錄得17宗成交，包括Central Residence By The Park的10個單位。

items.title: Hong Kong vs Singapore: Which City Demands a Bigger Living Cost?
items.title_zh: 香港與新加坡：哪個城市生活成本更高？
items.desc: A cost-of-living comparison between Hong Kong and Singapore. While Hong Kong's luxury urban lifestyle draws global talent, Singapore's affordability framework supports long-term living with fewer financial shocks.
items.desc_zh: 香港與新加坡的生活成本比較。雖然香港的豪華都市生活方式吸引全球人才，但新加坡的可負擔性框架支持長期居住，財務衝擊較少。

items.title: Prudential plc Share Repurchase - February 2026
items.title_zh: 保誠集團股份回購 - 2026年2月
items.desc: On 13 February 2026, Prudential repurchased 612,541 shares at an average price of GBP 10.6087 per share, representing 0.0241% of issued shares.
items.desc_zh: 2026年2月13日，保誠以每股10.6087英鎊的平均價格回購了612,541股，佔已發行股份的0.0241%。

items.title: Hong Kong Weekly Roundup: MTR Safety Upgrades
items.title_zh: 香港週報：港鐵安全升級
items.desc: Hong Kong weekly roundup for mid-February 2026 includes updates on Zoom web for hybrid work, EDB digital education push, and MTR safety upgrades.
items.desc_zh: 2026年2月中旬香港週報包括Zoom網頁混合工作更新、教育局數字教育推廣以及港鐵安全升級。

items.title: Airport Express Ticket Promotions Available on Klook
items.title_zh: 機場快線車票優惠在Klook上架
items.desc: Promo period: 19 Dec 2025 - 18 Feb 2026, quota will be released every Friday 12:00 noon by Klook on a first-come, first-served basis.
items.desc_zh: 優惠期：2025年12月19日至2026年2月18日，名額將於每週五中午12:00由Klook發放，先到先得。

sections.title: 📈 港股關注 - 萬國數據 GDS

items.title: Analyst Upgrade Followed GDS Holdings Convertible Notes Offering
items.title_zh: 分析師上調GDS Holdings評級，跟進可轉債發行
items.desc: J.P. Morgan analyst Gokul Hariharan raised the firm's price target on GDS Holdings from $40 to $55 while maintaining a Buy rating.
items.desc_zh: 摩根大通分析師Gokul Hariharan將GDS Holdings的目標價從40美元上調至55美元，同時維持買入評級。

items.title: Data centre operator DayOne aims to raise $5 billion in US IPO
items.title_zh: 數據中心運營商DayOne計劃在美國IPO籌資50億美元
items.desc: Global data centre operator DayOne, affiliated with China's GDS Holdings, aims to raise as much as $5 billion in a U.S. IPO. DayOne was rebranded from GDS International in January 2025.
items.desc_zh: 與中國GDS Holdings關聯的全球數據中心運營商DayOne計劃在美國IPO籌資高達50億美元。DayOne於2025年1月從GDS International更名。

items.title: GSA Capital Partners Makes New $1.58 Million Investment in GDS Holdings
items.title_zh: GSA Capital Partners對GDS Holdings新增158萬美元投資
items.desc: GSA Capital Partners LLP acquired a new position in GDS Holdings. Weiss Ratings reaffirmed a Buy-equivalent rating on the stock. One analyst rated Strong Buy, eight gave Buy, and four gave Hold ratings.
items.desc_zh: GSA Capital Partners LLP新建倉GDS Holdings。Weiss Ratings重申對該股的買入評級。一位分析師給予強烈買入評級，八位給予買入評級，四位給予持有評級。

items.title: DayOne Data Secures Banks for $5 Billion US IPO
items.title_zh: DayOne Data確定銀行承銷50億美元美國IPO
items.desc: If market volatility remains low, DayOne Data could launch its IPO in late 2026. AI-driven demand is strong and institutional investors are rotating into infrastructure plays.
items.desc_zh: 如果市場波動保持低位，DayOne Data可能在2026年底啟動IPO。AI驅動的需求強勁，機構投資者正轉向基礎設施投資。

items.title: GDS Holdings Valuation Check After Strong Recent Share Price Momentum
items.title_zh: GDS Holdings近期股價強勁上漲後的估值檢視
items.desc: With GDS Holdings now at $46.84 and sitting close to analyst targets, the key question is whether this rebound is still leaving the stock undervalued, or is the market already pricing in future growth?
items.desc_zh: GDS Holdings現價46.84美元，接近分析師目標價，關鍵問題是這次反彈是否仍使股票被低估，還是市場已經計入了未來增長？

items.title: Six flaws found hiding in OpenClaw's plumbing
items.title_zh: 發現OpenClaw系統中隱藏的六個漏洞
items.desc: Security researchers uncovered six high-to-critical flaws affecting OpenClaw, including SSRF, missing webhook authentication, authentication bypasses, and path traversal vulnerabilities.
items.desc_zh: 安全研究人員發現影響OpenClaw的六個高危至關鍵漏洞，包括SSRF、缺失的webhook認證、認證繞過和路徑遍歷漏洞。

items.title: First infostealer malware caught stealing OpenClaw AI agent credentials
items.title_zh: 首次發現竊取OpenClaw AI代理憑證的信息竊取惡意軟件
items.desc: Security researchers documented the first in-the-wild instance of infostealer malware successfully exfiltrating OpenClaw configuration files. The attack occurred on February 13, 2026.
items.desc_zh: 安全研究人員記錄了首次在野外發現的信息竊取惡意軟件成功竊取OpenClaw配置文件的實例。攻擊發生在2026年2月13日。

items.title: Netzilo AI Edge Delivers Enterprise-Grade Governance for OpenClaw Agents
items.title_zh: Netzilo AI Edge為OpenClaw代理提供企業級治理
items.desc: Netzilo AI Edge delivers enterprise-grade visibility, sandboxing, and governance for OpenClaw agents, announced on February 19, 2026.
items.desc_zh: Netzilo AI Edge於2026年2月19日宣布為OpenClaw代理提供企業級可見性、沙盒和治理功能。

items.title: Infostealer Found Stealing OpenClaw AI Identity and Memory Files
items.title_zh: 發現竊取OpenClaw AI身份和記憶文件的信息竊取程序
items.desc: Researchers at Hudson Rock identified a live infection where an infostealer exfiltrated a victim's OpenClaw configuration. The discovery highlights a shift in malware behavior toward harvesting personal AI identity files.
items.desc_zh: Hudson Rock研究人員發現了一起活躍感染，信息竊取程序竊取了受害者的OpenClaw配置。這一發現凸顯了惡意軟件行為向竊取個人AI身份文件的轉變。

items.title: Global Annual Semiconductor Sales Increase 25.6% to $791.7 Billion in 2025
items.title_zh: 2025年全球半導體銷售額增長25.6%達到7917億美元
items.desc: The Semiconductor Industry Association reports that global annual semiconductor sales increased 25.6% to $791.7 billion in 2025, driven by AI demand.
items.desc_zh: 半導體行業協會報告稱，受AI需求推動，2025年全球半導體年銷售額增長25.6%，達到7917億美元。

items.title: Nvidia's Huang says AI investment is just beginning, dismisses AI bubble fears
items.title_zh: 輝達黃仁勳稱AI投資才剛開始，駁斥AI泡沫擔憂
items.desc: Jensen Huang, CEO of Nvidia, said investment in artificial intelligence is only just beginning and could ultimately total tens of trillions of dollars, brushing aside skepticism over AI spending.
items.desc_zh: 輝達首席執行官黃仁勳表示，人工智能投資才剛剛開始，最終可能達到數十萬億美元，駁斥了對AI支出的懷疑。
